name: flubber
tagline: Smoothly turns one shape into another, such as a star into a circle, and splits one shape into several or joins several back into one.
author: Noah Veltman
settled: Finished, not abandoned: last push November 2022, but 162,000 npm downloads a week (week to 5 Nov 2026), 113 packages depend on it directly (deps.dev), and it is a small shape-maths library with nothing that goes out of date. Reviewed 2026-11-06.
